def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    rot180 = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[i] + cw[i] for i in range(n)] + [ccw[i] + rot180[i] for i in range(m)]
